PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_ONE: Currency converter in real-time bolivar to dollar and euro
PROJECT_FULL_DESCRIPTION_ONE:
A real-time calculator developed to convert amounts from bolívares to dollars and euros quickly and accurately.
This project was born as a practical solution for people who need to make constant and reliable conversions in their daily lives, without relying on heavy or unresponsive platforms.

Built with Next.js 15 and React, it leverages the power of Server-Side Rendering (SSR) to validate and update data directly from the API every 4 hours. This avoids unnecessary API requests on every page reload and leads to excellent JavaScript optimization. As a result, the user experience is significantly improved, especially when using mobile data.

The design was crafted with Tailwind CSS to ensure a clear, minimalist, and user-friendly interface across different devices. TypeScript adds precision in data handling and makes the project easier to maintain.

This calculator is not only a functional tool but also a great example of how modern development practices and efficient technologies can be combined to solve everyday problems faced by millions of Venezuelans.
PROJECT_DESCRIPTION_TWO: A practical and easy guide to Git & GitHub
PROJECT_FULL_DESCRIPTION_TWO:
GitGuide is an interactive guide created with the goal of helping you remember and learn the most useful Git and GitHub commands in a clear and accessible way.
The project was born out of a need: to have a reference that was not only functional but also pleasant for the user.

I used Astro as the main framework for the project. Markdown was used to render each section of the guide in a simple way, making the content easy to update and scale over time.

The design was crafted using Tailwind CSS to apply styles quickly. Each command is organized by category and purpose, accompanied by brief descriptions, so that both beginners and more advanced users can find what they need without wasting time.
PROJECT_FULL_DESCRIPTION_THREE:
A redesign of the Nothing Phone website, a brand known for its minimalist approach and futuristic aesthetics.

My main goal was to preserve the brand’s visual essence while giving it a more modern and efficient touch—both in performance and user experience.

Astro allowed me to precisely split components and deliver only the necessary JavaScript to the client, resulting in a smoother experience, especially on mobile devices. Tailwind CSS helped me work efficiently with utility-first classes to maintain a clean design aligned with Nothing’s visual identity. I also combined CSS animations to give it a unique, polished feel.

This redesign is not just a visual concept, but also a technical demonstration of how basic tools can be used to create faster, more accessible, and visually engaging web experiences without compromising the brand’s style and identity.
